description: App root and navigation shells differ per platform.
reason: Routing and navigation stacks are platform-specific.

description: Navigation link primitives differ across web and native.
reason: Integrates with react-router on web and react-navigation on native.

description: Virtualized list adapter uses different implementations on web and native.
reason: Uses react-virtuoso on web and React Native list primitives on native.

description: Reels desktop view implementation differs between web and native.
reason: Desktop vs mobile reels layout and gestures.
Web uses framer-motion library, native provides custom fallback that renders children without animations.

description: Onboarding form hook with platform-specific features.
reason: Web version includes Google Maps integration, responsive design logic, and script loading. Native version uses mobile-specific validation and callback-based navigation.

description: Media carousel component with platform-specific carousel implementations.
reason: Web uses Embla carousel with complex DOM event handling, HLS video, and responsive design. Native uses FlatList with simple touch gestures and expo-av Video component.

description: Message input component with platform-specific UI implementations for iMessage-style experience.
reason: Web uses AutoExpandingTextarea with DOM-based height calculation and CSS animations. Native uses React Native TextInput with KeyboardAvoidingView and platform-specific styling for optimal mobile UX.

description: Unified underline tabs component matching search Results/Saved styling.
reason: Web uses DOM Button and HTML elements. Native uses React Native Pressable and View for touch targets and layout.
